messages:
ana: Quick ask  - we need a short customer-facing runbook (one pager) for onboarding: cache, batch, stream. Make it actionable with 3 runnable snippets and 3 renewal signals.

drew: 👍 Keep it concise. My bullets: edge cache TTL 30s, client micro-batching (3-8) with ~50ms flush, streaming for chat with fallback after 300ms stall.

sam: Add a tiny validation harness customers can run: `for i in $(seq 1 8); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"sanity","max_tokens":32}'; done` -> measure median latency and tokens.

ana: Renewal signals to surface: cache hit rate, median tokens/session, streaming fallback rate. If cache hit <10% after 7d or tokens/session +25% WoW, flag CS.

drew: Snippets to include in one-pager: pre-warm curl, JS micro-batcher concept, and the validation harness. Also add one-liner troubleshooting: pin model, verify tokenization for prefixes, check routing in Console.

sam: Feedback capture: add 'was this helpful?' after stream, log anonymized prompt head (first 3 tokens), surface top failing prompts weekly to product.

cs-bot: Reminder: create Drive doc "CS Onboard - runtime quickrun" and set reviewers ana,drew,sam.

ana: I'll draft the one-pager and add to kickoff templates. Send to medium-risk renewals in week 2 for a proactive check-in. :thumbsup:
